newsitem.title: USA: Moderate quake hits Arkansas, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Moderate quake hits Arkansas, no damage reported.

text.p: A moderate earthquake jolted Arkansas early on Friday morning and was felt in four other states, but officials said there were no reports of injuries or damage.

The quake, which measured 4.3 on the open-ended Richter scale, struck at 0041 EST (0541 GMT) on the Arkansas-Missouri border, according to the U.S. Geological Survey's earthquake information centre in Golden, Colorado.
Officials said the quake's epicentre was near Blytheville in north-eastern Arkansas on the New Madrid fault line.

"This earthquake was felt in many parts of northeast Arkansas, western Kentucky, Tennessee, southwestern Missouri and southern Illinois," said a Geological Survey official. "There were no reports of damage."
